retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, centered facial portrait emerging from deep black shadows, framed by a thin cream border with gold-toned serif typography at the base.
excludeWhen: bright or colorful backgrounds are needed
modern sans-serif minimalist styles are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, symmetrical close-up of a face where features are defined by soft highlights against a total black void, anchored by a thin external border and bottom-aligned gold text.
coreVisualRelationships: Face-to-void ratio where the subject occupies the central 60% of the frame
Cream border framing the deep black canvas
Gold typography providing a horizontal anchor at the bottom third

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered close-up portrait, eyes positioned at the upper horizontal grid line.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes and the bridge of the nose serve as the primary focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the eyes down to the lips, then dropping to the centered text block at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounding the head, merging hair into the background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black for background and shadows
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale cream/off-white for the border and skin highlights
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high value contrast between highlights and shadows.

composition.relationshipToImage: overlaying the bottom of the portrait

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with varying scales for primary name and secondary tracklist.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic availability and similar serif structure
High contrast for a more fashion-forward look

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white portrait of a person with soft lighting on the face, surrounded by a total black background and a thin cream border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered gold serif text in all caps at the bottom, using wide tracking for the main name and smaller text for the sub-details.

verificationChecks: Is the face emerging from pure black?
Is the border a consistent thin cream line?
Is the text centered and gold-toned?
Is the lighting on the face soft yet high-contrast?

adjustableVariables: Amount of facial detail visible in the shadows
mustRedesign: Do not include specific artist names or song titles
Do not replicate the exact facial features of the original subject

mustAchieve: Seamless transition from hair to black background

postGenerationChecks: Check for total black levels in the background
Ensure text is perfectly centered horizontally
Verify the cream border is not cut off by the edge
recipe.reuseFormula: Chiaroscuro Portrait + Deep Black Void + Gold Serif Typography + Cream Frame
